title: Trump at ASEAN-US Summit: When there's a problem, call me
summary: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday reaffirmed the defense relationship between the Philippines and the US, adding that the two countries are closer now “because of our personal relationship.” At…

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday reaffirmed the defense relationship between the Philippines and the US, adding that the two countries are closer now “because of our personal relationship.”
At the start of the ASEAN-US Summit, Trump told President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. that he knew the Filipino leader’s parents “and they were great.”
Trump also gave a personal assurance to the US’ allies, saying they can call him if there was a problem.

“We've also significantly increased our defense cooperation with the Philippines, which historically has been a key US ally. But I don't think we've ever been closer than we are right now because of our personal relationship,” Trump said.

“And we support our partners and our allies 100 percent. And when there's a problem, you'll call me. You'll call Marco. You'll call others. And if they don't respond, call me. I'll take your call,” he added.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in the Philippines with Trump.
“I'll say, 'Marco, you're fired. You didn't respond fast enough,” Trump said in jest. –NB, GMA News
